title: Creation of heterogeneous metal-ceramic structures based on Ti, Ni and WC, В4С by the combined method of laser cladding and cold gas-dynamic spraying

experimentalProperties.Deposit_Post_Treatment_Description: Laser treatment of CS coatings was performed on a Sibir-1complex developed at ITAM SB RAS [10], which includes a continuous-wave CO2 laser with a power up to 5 kW and beam quality factor K = 0.7, as well as a computer-aided system for laser and process table control.

resultsValues.Microstructural_Features: CS coating, ceramic particles change in size (become smaller) as compared to the particles in the CS coating
